title: Planar Log-Brunn–Minkowski After Translation
exact_target: For planar convex bodies $K,L\in\mathcal K_2$, can the origin be positioned and $L$ translated so that $K$ and the translate satisfy the logarithmic Brunn–Minkowski inequality?
